author: GameSpot
description:
Presented by Takafumi Noma director (character designer, and scenario writer of Unicorn Overlord and former veteran of Vanillaware) × Good Smile Company, the new IP brand "IGNISPHERE" has officially launched.

We are excited to release this teaser trailer introducing an epic original world woven together by numerous nations and races.

■ New Game Currently in Development!
The first game based on the IGNISPHERE universe, an all-new Action RPG titled "DAWNGAZER," is currently in development.

■ "Dawngazer" Product Info
Planning & Development: Monochrome Corp.
Publishing & Promotion: Good Smile Company, Inc
Release Date: Scheduled for 2028
Platforms: Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Steam
Supported Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese (Traditional/Simplified)

author: GameSpot
description:
Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve picks up where Ace Combat 7 left off, underlining that the series is well and truly back to its best. The story could've been stronger--more introspective--but is entertaining regardless, and while there are some pacing issues with filler missions and some uneven momentum, much of the game is excellent, providing the series' signature blend of melodrama, stirring music, and thrilling aerial combat.
